name: goldilocks
description: A Direct-first Superpowers replacement that loads project workflow only when a concrete trigger earns it.

interface.shortDescription: Direct by default; structure only when earned
interface.longDescription: Provides a thin Goldilocks router plus optional brainstorming, planning, debugging, testing, continuity, delegation, and verification capabilities. Clear work exits to Direct without loading workflow references; durable, risky, or genuinely parallel work loads only the capability whose trigger is present.
defaultPrompt: Default to Direct; load no Goldilocks engine unless a concrete trigger changes the outcome.
Use continuity for long work, deliberate verification for high-risk work, and delegation only when ready units have net benefit.
Keep Lead on intent and integration; give Fast complete contracts and Standard only bounded domain judgment.
